title: Codex worker delegations in isolated worktrees fail immediately: local terminal execution unavailable
outcome: A Codex worker delegation with an isolatedWorktree write policy can start a terminal or shell in its worktree and run commands. When it cannot, the parent is told at once by a delegation failure that names the cause, not by a silent end. Proven by a delegation that runs a trivial command in its worktree on the running host.
acceptance: Codex worker delegations in isolated worktrees fail immediately: local terminal execution unavailable is done
